items.headline: Pitch Black's Troy Tobin on where Rising Sun's REVIZE is now headed
items.excerpt: Rising Sun Pictures' machine-learning face and performance tool REVIZE is expanding into new territory under Pitch Black. Troy Tobin explains where the ML tech is being pushed next in production.

items.headline: AI Filmmaking's Future Debated by Alibaba, Sonilo and PROMPTR Executives at Venice
items.excerpt: Executives from Alibaba, Sonilo and PROMPTR debated AI filmmaking's future at a TapNow/Dogme23 panel in Venice, unveiling a Creator Growth Plan.

items.headline: Utopai Studios, DeNA Team on AI-Assisted Animation Projects in Japan
items.excerpt: Utopai Studios and DeNA will explore AI-assisted animation production in Japan, with artists retaining final creative control.

items.headline: Adobe Unveils New Generative Media Tool in Premiere, Plus More AI-Powered Updates
items.excerpt: More AI-powered tools and upgrades are coming to Premiere and After Effects as Adobe has unveiled its latest updates at IBC 2026.

items.headline: More AI Editing Assistance Is on the Way as Eddie AI V4 Is Unveiled Ahead of IBC
items.excerpt: Eddie V4 has been released, promising even more features for the AI assistant editor, including some powered-up upgrades.

items.headline: DaVinci Resolve Gets AI Assistant Integration and Other New Features
items.excerpt: Blackmagic Design has rolled out its latest update for DaVinci Resolve (version 21.1), introducing AI assistant integration and over 100 new tools and controls. Here’s what you need to know.

items.headline: Adobe's IBC release for Premiere and After Effects
items.excerpt: Adobe's IBC 2026 release brings AI-generated video directly inside the Premiere Pro timeline, alongside new AI-assisted tools across After Effects. Scott Simmons breaks down what actually lands in the edit suite.

items.headline: Origami Platform Updates Media Management, Audio Conform, Security and AI Capabilities
items.excerpt: Cloud post-production platform Origami has released new capabilities spanning the full post workflow, from on-set media management to audio conform. The update adds AI capabilities aimed at cutting manual prep across the pipeline.

items.headline: Indie VG 'Astro Burn' Starts New Level with AI-Powered Animated Micro-Series
items.excerpt: 'Astro Burn's cuddly hero is embarking on new missions in an animated micro-series from Beyond the Pixels and AI animation co. Nura.
